structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun coin created about 11 minutes before detection. It is named "Roaring Kitty" (ticker ROARINGCAT) and its description says "Fees to @theroaringkitty via UsePaid", which means creator fees are routed to Keith Gill's X handle through a third-party fee-routing app. There is no sign Gill is involved. The coin had a sharp 5-minute burst of about $60k volume and about +500-700%, peaking near $35k market cap. It had already fallen about 30% in the last 5 minutes (GeckoTerminal) to about $21.5k. Other Roaring Kitty tokens were launched 6-7 minutes later (RK, a ROARINGCAT copy), so snipers and copycats are active. I found no fresh confirmed post from Gill. The latest news is unverified "Mr. Wizard" speculation from September 21 and a hacked-account RKC incident in May 2026.

narrative.description: Keith Gill (Roaring Kitty) celebrity-fee token. A recurring meme-stock hero narrative, but he is currently inactive. The only recent news is unverified speculation from September 21 about an old account, plus a May 2026 hacked-account memecoin incident.
narrative.why_spreading: Probably pump.fun trenches bot and bundle activity around a famous name, plus the 'fees to celebrity handle' format. I found no confirmed new catalyst from Gill today.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the first of this burst of same-name launches (created 03:05, before the RK and ROARINGCAT copies at about 03:11-03:12). It routes fees to the real handle, but Gill has not endorsed it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Many Roaring Kitty tokens (KITTY $246k older, RK and ROARINGCAT copies launched minutes later, RKT, DFV). None of them is canonical.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 154 of 247 holders as bundler wallets, and the top bundler trader share is 31%. The creator has launched 29 tokens and its best ATH is $35k. The linked dev X account has 2,181 launches, which suggests the X account is a UsePaid-style platform or serial launcher. Volume came almost entirely in one 5-minute burst, and buyers (533) and sellers (367) are nearly balanced.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts. A real Roaring Kitty signal could exist and not yet be indexed.

structural_risks: Already off about 30% from the ATH within minutes
Still on the bonding curve, about 66% of the way to migration

structured_output.counterargument: Roaring Kitty is one of the strongest crypto-meme names (see the 2024 memecoin surges and May 2026 RKC hitting $12M in minutes). If Gill posts anything, or the September 21 speculation grows, the first ROARINGCAT on pump.fun could multiply fast from a $21k base. Mint and freeze authority are renounced and the top 10 hold only about 20%.
